literal: Bao Xian; Pi Jinghe; Xianyu Shirong; Qilian Meng; Yuan Jing'an; Dugu Yongye; Fu Fu; Gao Baoning
idiomatic: Bao Xian; Pi Jinghe; Xianyu Shirong; Qilian Meng; Yuan Jing'an; Dugu Yongye; Fu Fu; Gao Baoning

literal: Bao Xian, styled Sizu, was a man of Chiqiu in Wei commandery.
idiomatic: Bao Xian, styled Sizu, came from Chiqiu in Wei commandery.

literal: His grandfather Kai was Wei governor of Langye and inspector of Shuozhou; the family then settled on the northern frontier.
idiomatic: His grandfather Kai had been Wei governor of Langye and inspector of Shuozhou; the family then settled on the northern frontier.

literal: His father Dan was Wei inspector of Hengzhou and left guard general, Duke of Le'an.
idiomatic: His father Dan was Wei inspector of Hengzhou and left guard general, Duke of Le'an.

literal: When Xian was young he saw a monk point at him and say: "This lad has a fine physiognomy; in the end he will surely become a good general, noble to the utmost as a minister.
idiomatic: When Xian was young a monk pointed at him and said, "This lad has a fine face; in the end he will surely become a good general, noble to the utmost among ministers.

literal: " When the words ended the monk was lost; none knew where he had gone.
idiomatic: " When the words ended the monk was gone; none knew where he had gone.

literal: Xian from youth had seen military service and was skilled at riding and archery; he once followed Emperor Xiaozhuang of Wei on a hunt and in one day with his own hands took seventy-three birds and beasts.
idiomatic: From youth Xian had seen military service and was skilled at riding and archery. He once followed Emperor Xiaozhuang of Wei on a hunt and in one day took seventy-three birds and beasts with his own hands.

literal: In the second year of Xiaochang he was made supervisor of the Feathered Forest.
idiomatic: In the second Xiaochang year he was made supervisor of the feathered forest.

literal: In the first year of Zhongxing he was made General Who Displays Might and chief clerk of Jinzhou's chariot-and-horse office.
idiomatic: In the first Zhongxing year he was made general who displays might and chief clerk of Jinzhou's chariot-and-horse office.

literal: Later he followed Gao Huan in raising the righteous army at Xindu and was appointed steadfast general, scattered cavalry attendant, great commander within the tent, additionally made general who pacifies the east and grand master with silver-blue-gleaming cap, and Marquis of Tunliu county with a state fief.
idiomatic: Later he followed Gao Huan in raising the righteous army at Xindu and was appointed steadfast general, scattered-cavalry attendant, and great commander within the tent, with additional rank as general who pacifies the east and grand master with silver-blue-gleaming cap, and as marquis of Tunliu county with a state fief.

literal: In the second year of Tianping he was made administrator of Bohai commandery.
idiomatic: In the second Tianping year he was made administrator of Bohai commandery.

literal: In the first year of Yuanxiang he was made chief rectifier of Yunzhou, concurrently general of the martial guard, and additionally general who pacifies the east.
idiomatic: In the first Yuanxiang year he was made chief rectifier of Yunzhou, concurrently general of the martial guard, with additional rank as general who pacifies the east.

literal: In the second year he was made inspector of Northern Xuzhou and grand commander of that province.
idiomatic: In the second year he was made inspector of Northern Xuzhou and grand commander of that province.

literal: He followed Gao Huan in fighting the western army at Mount Mang; Gao Huan ordered Xian to hold Heqiao garrison and occupy Zhongyong city.
idiomatic: He followed Gao Huan in fighting the western army at Mount Mang. Gao Huan ordered Xian to hold Heqiao garrison and occupy Zhongyong city.

literal: In the second year of Wuding he was made general who campaigns south and inspector of Guangzhou.
idiomatic: In the second Wuding year he was made general who campaigns south and inspector of Guangzhou.

literal: Hou Jing rebelled in Henan and attacked him; Xian led a little more than twenty horsemen of his close guard and burst out of the rebel camp, broke through hardship, and returned to the state.
idiomatic: Hou Jing rebelled in Henan and attacked him. Xian led a little more than twenty horsemen of his close guard, burst out of the rebel camp, broke through hardship, and returned to the state.

literal: At the time Gao Yue and Murong Shaozong and others were campaigning against Jing; they at once assigned Xian troops and horses, and he followed Yue and the rest in defeating Jing at Woyang.
idiomatic: At the time Gao Yue, Murong Shaozong, and others were campaigning against Jing. They at once assigned Xian troops and horses, and he followed Yue and the rest in defeating Jing at Woyang.

literal: In the sixth year of Wuding he was appointed director of the grand treasury.
idiomatic: In the sixth Wuding year he was appointed director of the grand treasury.

literal: He followed Gao Cheng in pacifying Wang Sizheng at Yingchuan and was appointed inspector of Yingzhou.
idiomatic: He followed Gao Cheng in pacifying Wang Sizheng at Yingchuan and was appointed inspector of Yingzhou.

literal: In the seventh year he was transferred to inspector of Zhengzhou.
idiomatic: In the seventh year he was transferred to inspector of Zhengzhou.

literal: In the eighth year he was additionally made general of the swift cavalry; his marquisate was advanced to a duchy, and with prior fiefs the food households totaled one thousand three hundred.
idiomatic: In the eighth year he was additionally made general of the swift cavalry; his marquisate was advanced to a duchy, and with prior fiefs the food households totaled one thousand three hundred.

literal: In the first year of Tianbao he was additionally made great general of the guards; his inspectorship was unchanged.
idiomatic: In the first Tianbao year he was additionally made great general of the guards; his inspectorship was unchanged.

literal: In the third year, together with Prince of Qinghe Gao Yue, he raided Liyang and took it.
idiomatic: In the third year, together with Prince of Qinghe Gao Yue, he raided Liyang and took it.

literal: For bribe goods he was removed from Zhengzhou and confined by the Court of Review.
idiomatic: For taking bribes he was removed from Zhengzhou and confined by the court of review.

literal: Before the sentence was finished, Hefei was besieged; he was sent with Buhan Sa, Murong Yan, and others jointly to attack Liang's Northern Xuzhou.
idiomatic: Before the sentence was finished, Hefei was besieged; he was sent with Buhan Sa, Murong Yan, and others jointly to attack Liang's Northern Xuzhou.

literal: They captured Inspector Wang Qiang.
idiomatic: They captured inspector Wang Qiang.

literal: They fought Liang's inspector of Qinzhou Yan Chaoda at Jingcheng and defeated him.
idiomatic: They fought Liang inspector of Qinzhou Yan Chaoda at Jingcheng and defeated him.

literal: In the fifth year he was appointed equal in rank to the Three Excellencies.
idiomatic: In the fifth year he was appointed equal in rank to the three excellencies.

literal: That same year he again followed Gao Yue south to the Han River and attacked and took Liang's Western Chuzhou, capturing Inspector Xu Faguang.
idiomatic: That same year he again followed Gao Yue south to the Han River, attacked and took Liang's Western Chuzhou, and captured inspector Xu Faguang.

literal: At the time Liang generals Xiao Xun and Hou Zhen and others besieged Murong Yan at Yingzhou; Xian was again made grand commander of the water army and entered the river from Shekou to rescue him.
idiomatic: At the time Liang generals Xiao Xun and Hou Zhen and others besieged Murong Yan at Yingzhou. Xian was again made grand commander of the water army and entered the river from Shekou to rescue him.

literal: When the army returned he was additionally made opener of the government with rank equal to the Three Excellencies and rewarded with five hundred bolts of silk.
idiomatic: When the army returned he was additionally made opener of the government with rank equal to the three excellencies and rewarded with five hundred bolts of silk.

literal: In the tenth year he drew salary from the dry fief of Fanyang commandery in Youzhou.
idiomatic: In the tenth year he drew salary from the dry fief of Fanyang commandery in Youzhou.

literal: In the first year of Qianming he was made great general of the chariots and cavalry.
idiomatic: In the first Qianming year he was made great general of the chariots and cavalry.

literal: In the first year of Huangjian his fief was changed to Duke of Le'an commandery with a state.
idiomatic: In the first Huangjian year his fief was changed to duke of Le'an commandery with a state.

literal: In the second year he was made inspector of Zhaozhou.
idiomatic: In the second year he was made inspector of Zhaozhou.

literal: In the first year of Heqing he was moved to inspector of Luozhou.
idiomatic: In the first Heqing year he was moved to inspector of Luozhou.

literal: In the second year he was again made inspector of Shuozhou; when his term ended he returned home.
idiomatic: In the second year he was again made inspector of Shuozhou; when his term ended he returned home.

literal: In the first year of Tiantong he was specially advanced and made general of the swift cavalry, enfeoffed as Prince of Dingyang.
idiomatic: In the first Tiantong year he was specially advanced and made general of the swift cavalry, enfeoffed as prince of Dingyang.

literal: In the fourth year he died, aged sixty-six.
idiomatic: In the fourth year he died, aged sixty-six.

literal: Pi Jinghe was a man of Xiapi in Langye.
idiomatic: Pi Jinghe came from Xiapi in Langye.

literal: His father Qingbin was staff officer for military affairs in the establishment office of Wei Prince of Huainan.
idiomatic: His father Qingbin was staff officer for military affairs in the establishment office of Wei Prince of Huainan.

literal: In the Zhenguang era, while on mission to Huaishuo, he met the age's disorder and thereupon made his home in Shimen county of Guangning.
idiomatic: In the Zhenguang era, while on mission to Huaishuo, he met the age's disorder and made his home in Shimen county of Guangning.

literal: Jinghe from youth was quick and perceptive and skilled at riding and archery.
idiomatic: Jinghe from youth was quick and perceptive and skilled at riding and archery.

literal: At first he served Gao Huan as a trusted intimate; later he was made deputy commander of trusted intimates.
idiomatic: At first he served Gao Huan as a trusted intimate; later he was made deputy commander of trusted intimates.

literal: In the second year of Wuding he campaigned against the Buroq.
idiomatic: In the second Wuding year he campaigned against the Buroq.

literal: Gao Cheng suspected the bandits had an ambush and ordered Jinghe to take five or six horsemen deep into one valley; they met more than a hundred bandits and at once joined battle. Jinghe shot several tens of men, and none failed to fall at the twang of the string.
idiomatic: Gao Cheng suspected the bandits had laid an ambush and ordered Jinghe to take five or six horsemen deep into one valley. They met more than a hundred bandits and at once joined battle. Jinghe shot several tens of men, and none failed to fall at the twang of the string.

literal: Gao Huan once had Jinghe shoot a wild boar; with one arrow he took it. Gao Huan admired him deeply and made him straight commander of the storehouse.
idiomatic: Gao Huan once had Jinghe shoot a wild boar; with one arrow he took it. Gao Huan admired him deeply and made him straight commander of the storehouse.

literal: At the beginning of Tianbao he was given acting credentials, made inspector of Tongzhou, and enfeoffed as Baron of Yongning county with a state.
idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianbao he was given acting credentials, made inspector of Tongzhou, and enfeoffed as baron of Yongning county with a state.

literal: Later he followed the raid on the Kumo Xi and was additionally made great commander of the left and right.
idiomatic: Later he followed the raid on the Kumo Xi and was additionally made great commander of the left and right.

literal: He again followed the crossing of Huanglong, the campaign against the Khitan, and the pacification of the Jiehu.
idiomatic: He again followed the crossing of Huanglong, the campaign against the Khitan, and the pacification of the Jiehu.

literal: Soon he again followed the campaign against the Rouran ruler Anluochen north of the pass and again followed the pacification of the Rouran remnant embers.
idiomatic: Soon he again followed the campaign against the Rouran ruler Anluochen north of the pass and again followed the pacification of the Rouran remnant embers.

literal: Jinghe was nimble and had martial use; whenever there was military achievement it was his.
idiomatic: Jinghe was nimble and had martial use; whenever there was achievement in battle it was his.

literal: In the tenth year he drew salary from the dry fief of Anle commandery.
idiomatic: In the tenth year he drew salary from the dry fief of Anle commandery.

literal: In the first year of Qianming he was made general of the martial guard, concurrently gentleman attendant of the yellow gate.
idiomatic: In the first Qianming year he was made general of the martial guard, concurrently gentleman attendant of the yellow gate.

literal: When Gao Yan served as chief minister, in his original office he acted as staff deliberator in the great chancellor's government office.
idiomatic: When Gao Yan served as chief minister, in his original office he acted as staff deliberator in the great chancellor's government office.

literal: In the first year of Daning he was made equal in rank to the Three Excellencies, scattered cavalry regular attendant, and great general of the martial guard; soon he was additionally made opener of the government.
idiomatic: In the first Daning year he was made equal in rank to the three excellencies, scattered-cavalry regular attendant, and great general of the martial guard; soon he was additionally made opener of the government.

literal: In the second year he went out as inspector of Liangzhou.
idiomatic: In the second year he went out as inspector of Liangzhou.

literal: In the third year the Turks pressed and besieged Jinyang; Jinghe was ordered to ride post-horses to the capital, supervise and lead the rear army to Bingzhou, but before he arrived the bandits had already withdrawn.
idiomatic: In the third year the Turks pressed and besieged Jinyang. Jinghe was ordered to ride post-horses to the capital, supervise and lead the rear army to Bingzhou, but before he arrived the bandits had already withdrawn.

literal: He was then made great general who leads the left and right, drew salary from the dry fief of Qi commandery, and was again made director of the five armies in the metropolitan office.
idiomatic: He was then made great general who leads the left and right, drew salary from the dry fief of Qi commandery, and was again made director of the five armies in the metropolitan office.

literal: In the first year of Tiantong he was moved to director of the palace department.
idiomatic: In the first Tiantong year he was moved to director of the palace department.

literal: In the second year he was made attendant-in-ordinary.
idiomatic: In the second year he was made attendant-in-ordinary.

literal: Among military offices Jinghe also excelled at civil affairs, and his nature and judgment were even and fair; therefore he repeatedly received fine appointments.
idiomatic: Among military offices Jinghe also excelled at civil affairs, and his nature and judgment were even and fair; therefore he repeatedly received fine appointments.

literal: After peace was made with Zhou, envoys came and went; Jinghe was constantly ordered to receive them. Whenever he shot together with the envoys, a hundred shots brought a hundred hits, and he was greatly esteemed.
idiomatic: After peace was made with Zhou, envoys came and went, and Jinghe was constantly ordered to receive them. Whenever he shot together with the envoys, a hundred shots brought a hundred hits, and he was greatly esteemed.

literal: In the Wuping era the imperial prison often had inner yellow gate men and others supervise cases; Jinghe was constantly ordered to review and verify them. Holding to reason and acting upright, thereby no case was wrongly excessive.
idiomatic: In the Wuping era the imperial prison often had inner yellow-gate men and others supervise cases; Jinghe was constantly ordered to review and verify them. Holding to reason and acting upright, thereby no case was wrongly excessive.

literal: Later he was made specially advanced and central commander of the guards, enfeoffed as Duke of Guanghan commandery with a state.
idiomatic: Later he was made specially advanced and central commander of the guards, enfeoffed as duke of Guanghan commandery with a state.

literal: He again followed Hulu Guang in leading troops on a western campaign and took the two cities of Yaoxiang and Baiting; he was separately enfeoffed as Duke of Yongning commandery with a state.
idiomatic: He again followed Hulu Guang in leading troops on a western campaign and took the two cities of Yaoxiang and Baiting; he was separately enfeoffed as duke of Yongning commandery with a state.

literal: He was again made general who commands the army.
idiomatic: He was again made general who commands the army.

literal: He again followed the army in taking Yiyang city and was enfeoffed as Duke of Kaifeng commandery with a state.
idiomatic: He again followed the army in taking Yiyang city and was enfeoffed as duke of Kaifeng commandery with a state.

literal: When Prince of Langye killed He Shikai, troops pointed at the western gate-tower; inside and outside were fearful and none knew what to do.
idiomatic: When Prince of Langye killed He Shikai, troops pointed at the western gate-tower; inside and outside were fearful and none knew what to do.

literal: Jinghe asked the Later Sovereign to go out through the Qianqiu Gate and issue commands himself.
idiomatic: Jinghe asked the Later Sovereign to go out through the Qianqiu Gate and issue commands himself.

literal: When the affair was settled he was made right vice director of the masters of writing and inspector of Zhaozhou.
idiomatic: When the affair was settled he was made right vice director of the masters of writing and inspector of Zhaozhou.

literal: Soon he was moved to right vice director of the masters of writing on the Henan mobile staff and inspector of Luozhou.
idiomatic: Soon he was moved to right vice director of the masters of writing on the Henan mobile staff and inspector of Luozhou.

literal: Liang general Wu Mingche invaded Huainan; Jinghe was ordered to lead troops to resist him. He was made great general who commands the army, enfeoffed as Prince of Wencheng commandery, and transferred his salary to the dry fief of Gaoyang commandery.
idiomatic: Liang general Wu Mingche invaded Huainan; Jinghe was ordered to lead troops to resist him. He was made great general who commands the army, enfeoffed as prince of Wencheng commandery, and transferred his salary to the dry fief of Gaoyang commandery.

literal: When the army reached Zhakou, local men Chen Xuan and others rose in disorder; Jinghe pacified them.
idiomatic: When the army reached Zhakou, local men Chen Xuan and others rose in disorder; Jinghe pacified them.

literal: There was also Yangping man Zheng Zirao, who falsely relied on the Buddha Way, set up vegetarian feasts, used little rice and flour yet supplied provisions very broadly, and secretly from underground gradually produced cakes and rice—fools took it for divine power, and he was believed between Wei and Wei.
idiomatic: There was also Yangping man Zheng Zirao, who falsely relied on the Buddha Way, set up vegetarian feasts, used little rice and flour yet supplied provisions very broadly, and secretly from underground gradually produced cakes and rice. Fools took it for divine power, and he won belief between Wei and Wei.

literal: He was about to make rebellion; the plot leaked and he was seized in a surprise attack, but escaped through a gap.
idiomatic: He was about to rebel; the plot leaked and he was seized in a surprise attack, but escaped through a gap.

literal: He then secretly crossed the river, gathered several thousand men, styled himself Prince of Changle, had already taken Chengyi county, and again intended to raid the city of Western Yanzhou.
idiomatic: He then secretly crossed the river, gathered several thousand men, styled himself prince of Changle, had already taken Chengyi county, and again intended to raid the city of Western Yanzhou.

literal: Jinghe sent several hundred horsemen from Southern Yanzhou and defeated them, beheading more than two thousand, capturing Zirao alive, and sending him to the capital to be boiled.
idiomatic: Jinghe sent several hundred horsemen from Southern Yanzhou and defeated them, beheading more than two thousand, capturing Zirao alive, and sending him to the capital to be boiled.

literal: When Wu Mingche besieged Shouyang, an edict ordered Jinghe to go with Heba Fu'en and others to the rescue.
idiomatic: When Wu Mingche besieged Shouyang, an edict ordered Jinghe to go with Heba Fu'en and others to the rescue.

literal: Jinghe, because the army of Wei Pohu had first suffered defeat, was timid and did not dare advance; he halted the army at Huaikou. Edict envoys repeatedly came to urge him on, yet only then did he cross the Huai.
idiomatic: Jinghe, because the army of Wei Pohu had first suffered defeat, was timid and did not dare advance; he halted the army at Huaikou. Edict envoys repeatedly came to urge him on, yet only then did he cross the Huai.

literal: It happened that Shouyang had already fallen; he fled north in disorder, and weapons and military stores were for the most part lost.
idiomatic: It happened that Shouyang had already fallen; he fled north in disorder, and weapons and military stores were for the most part lost.

literal: Liang general Xiao Mohe led infantry and cavalry and intercepted him at Cangling city north of the Huai; Jinghe got his troops in order and fought him in reverse; Mohe withdrew and returned.
idiomatic: Liang general Xiao Mohe led infantry and cavalry and intercepted him at Cangling city north of the Huai. Jinghe got his troops in order and fought him in reverse; Mohe withdrew and returned.

literal: At the time many who resisted Wu Mingche met ruin; only Jinghe returned with the whole army intact, and thereby he received reward: he was made director of the masters of writing, separately enfeoffed as Duke of Xihe commandery with a state, and given two hundred thousand in cash plus ten cartloads of wine and rice.
idiomatic: At the time many who resisted Wu Mingche met ruin; only Jinghe returned with the whole army intact, and thereby he received reward. He was made director of the masters of writing, separately enfeoffed as duke of Xihe commandery with a state, and given two hundred thousand in cash plus ten cartloads of wine and rice.

literal: At the time Liang voices said they would cross the Huai; Jinghe was ordered to halt the army in Western Yanzhou as commander for defense and resistance.
idiomatic: At the time Liang voices said they would cross the Huai; Jinghe was ordered to halt the army in Western Yanzhou as commander for defense and resistance.

literal: In the sixth year of Wuping he died of illness, aged fifty-five.
idiomatic: In the sixth Wuping year he died of illness, aged fifty-five.

literal: Posthumously he was given attendant-in-ordinary, bearer of the staff of authority, commander-in-chief of the six provinces Ding, Heng, Shuo, You, Ding, and Ping, Duke of the Grand Commandant, recorder of the masters of writing affairs, and inspector of Dingzhou.
idiomatic: Posthumously he was given attendant-in-ordinary, bearer of the staff of authority, commander-in-chief of the six provinces Ding, Heng, Shuo, You, Ding, and Ping, duke of the grand commandant, recorder of the masters of writing affairs, and inspector of Dingzhou.

literal: His eldest son Xin was quick-witted and had bearing; he lightly dipped into books and records.
idiomatic: His eldest son Xin was quick-witted and had bearing; he lightly dipped into books and records.

literal: Late in Wuping he was opener of the government with rank equal to the Three Excellencies and general of the martial guard; among sons of meritorious nobles he was praised for discernment.
idiomatic: Late in Wuping he was opener of the government with rank equal to the three excellencies and general of the martial guard; among sons of meritorious nobles he was praised for discernment.

literal: At Bingzhou he surrendered to the Zhou army and was appointed supreme opener of the government and rectifier of the army.
idiomatic: At Bingzhou he surrendered to the Zhou army and was appointed supreme opener of the government and rectifier of the army.

literal: In the Kaihuang era of Sui he died as inspector of Taozhou.
idiomatic: In the Kaihuang era of Sui he died as inspector of Taozhou.

literal: His younger son Sudda, late in Wuping, was director of fasts for the heir apparent; he had literary talent and restrained conduct.
idiomatic: His younger son Sudda, late in Wuping, was director of fasts for the heir apparent; he had literary talent and restrained conduct.

literal: In the Kaihuang era he was communications attendant.
idiomatic: In the Kaihuang era he was communications attendant.

literal: When his mother's mourning ended he was recalled to service; about to go to the capital, he took leave of the spirit tablet, wailed in grief, and stopped breathing; long after he revived but could not take food, and on the third day he died.
idiomatic: When his mother's mourning ended he was recalled to service. About to go to the capital, he took leave of the spirit tablet, wailed in grief, and stopped breathing. Long after he revived but could not take food, and on the third day he died.

literal: Xianyu Shirong was a man of Yuyang.
idiomatic: Xianyu Shirong came from Yuyang.

literal: His father Baoye was garrison commander of Huaishuo; early in Wuping he was posthumously given equal rank to the Three Excellencies, director of the ministry of sacrifices, and inspector of Shuozhou.
idiomatic: His father Baoye was garrison commander of Huaishuo; early in Wuping he was posthumously given equal rank to the three excellencies, director of the ministry of sacrifices, and inspector of Shuozhou.

literal: Shirong from youth was deep and keen and had capacity and backbone.
idiomatic: Shirong from youth was deep and keen and had capacity and backbone.

literal: In the second year of Xinghe he was Gao Huan's deputy commander of trusted intimates; he was gradually promoted to general who pacifies the west and ennobled as Baron of Shimen county.
idiomatic: In the second Xinghe year he was Gao Huan's deputy commander of trusted intimates; he was gradually promoted to general who pacifies the west and ennobled as baron of Shimen county.

literal: Later he repeatedly followed Gao Yang in campaigning against the Rouran and defeating the Jiehu.
idiomatic: Later he repeatedly followed Gao Yang in campaigning against the Rouran and defeating the Jiehu.

literal: He again followed Gao Yue in pacifying Yingzhou and was made bearer of the staff of authority and inspector of Hezhou, drawing salary from the dry fief of Chaoge county.
idiomatic: He again followed Gao Yue in pacifying Yingzhou and was made bearer of the staff of authority and inspector of Hezhou, drawing salary from the dry fief of Chaoge county.

literal: Soon he was made deliberator of staff affairs in Gao Yan's chancellor government office.
idiomatic: Soon he was made deliberator of staff affairs in Gao Yan's chancellor government office.
